entries.title: AI Automation Agency-in-a-Box
entries.targetAudience: Agencies, consultants, founders and service resellers
entries.description: AI Automation Agency-in-a-Box — Packaged launch offers with client acquisition, fulfillment and delivery controls. Focus on a clear user input, an inspectable output and a productized operating benefit.
entries.problem: The buyer needs a repeatable, measurable workflow rather than disconnected forms and manual research.

inputs: Offer niche, brand and ideal customer
Service scope, deliverables and cost structure
Fulfillment workflow and responsible operators
workflow: Accept and validate user-provided data and permissions
Apply documented business rules to produce a domain-specific result
Display assumptions, exceptions and the next action
Allow copying or exporting a structured deliverable without claiming live integrations
Only execute external actions with separately authorized and verified service connections
acceptanceCriteria: A nonempty, valid input produces a meaningful domain-specific result
Invalid input is rejected with a useful message
All unverified data and integrations are visibly labeled
Output can be reviewed and reused; no silent outbound action

integrationRequirements: Verified provider API contracts when external data is required
Role-scoped access and tenant separation if accounts are connected
Explicit approval or consent for messages, writes and data transfers

Service scope, deliverables and cost structure
Fulfillment workflow and responsible operators
safety: Do not fabricate live data, customer outcomes or provider integrations
